data.current_description:
**Gateway:** `/ifood/limits`

Consulta o limite do cliente. Caso não exista limite ativo/válido,
a API chama o motor de crédito (KDE) para recalcular e retorna o limite atualizado.

`limite_disponivel = valor_KDE - SUM(customer_limit_provision) - SUM(boletos_em_aberto_sellers_koin_ifood)`
data.summary_suggestion: Query customer credit limit with recalculation
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves the customer's current credit limit. If no active or valid limit exists, automatically invokes the credit engine (KDE) to recalculate and returns the updated limit. Available credit is calculated as: KDE value minus customer limit provisions minus outstanding invoices from Koin-iFood sellers. Requires customer identification (CPF). Returns complete limit information including total limit, available credit, and calculation details.
